82649: Tomoya is not only popular among girls, but he's also a player. A narcissistic guy who flirts and constantly and steals the hearts of many girls in his school. But what if there is one who doesn't fall for his good looks? He's a bit overprotective of his younger sister.
83681: Natsuki is a shy boy with a good heart and dreaming nature. He's energetic, delusional, and like a girl when it comes to affairs of the heart. On the day his heart gets broken, he meets a mysterious girl who he can't stop thinking of.
83683: Keiichi is an boy who knows what he wants. And what he wants is the ultimate masochist girlfriend who he can realize his sadistic fantasies with. Will he ever find her? Or will he have to raise one from scratch? His older brother is a teacher in their school.
83685: An otaku and unpredictable guy. Tsuyoshi looks like he's only interested in otaku stuff, so how come he's the only one of his group of friends with an actual, stable relationship?
89265: Mari is a tsundere girl who loves her best friend Anna and truly hates men. But above all, she hates Natsuki, who tries to steal Anna from her and Tomoya, who for some reason seems to be interested in Mari.
89266: Anna is a polite girl who's good at studies and who lives at her own pace. That is, until she meets Natsuki and finds herself spending more and more time with him. She's usually accompanied by her best friend Mari.
89267: Yukiko is always full of energy and positive thinking, which makes her quite an odd couple with her boyfriend Tsuyoshi. She loves cosplaying and has very good interpersonal skills. She goes to a different school than all the main characters.
89268: Nozomi is Tomoya's little sister who will do everything to reach the heart of her love interest. Unfortunately for Tomoya, she falls in love with the last person he would want her to.
264681: Natsuki's classmate and captain of the girl's volleyball club.
